guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile build fails at the step: RUN npm install -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli && playwright install --with-deps. The error log indicates the node version is v12.22.9, which is incompatible with multiple npm packages (including @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli and puppeteer) that require Node.js version >=14 or even >=18. This causes npm install to fail with unsupported engine errors and a syntax error due to unsupported JavaScript syntax in the outdated Node.js version. The root cause is that the base Ubuntu 22.04 image ships with an old Node.js version which does not meet the package requirements. To fix this issue, the Dockerfile should explicitly upgrade or install a newer Node.js version (at least v18) before running npm global installs. This can be done by installing NodeSource Node.js binaries or using nvm, for example adding steps to install Node.js 18 or later. Please update the Dockerfile to properly install a supported Node.js version just before the npm install and playwright install commands.
